messages.content: 紐約目前的交通狀況如何？

function.name: geocode_address
function.description: Transforms a description of a location (like a pair of coordinates, an address, or a name of a place) to a location on the Earth's surface. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

address.description: The address that needs to be geocoded.

locale.description: Preferred locale for the returned address information. (Optional) Default: None

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法取得即時的交通資訊。若您想了解紐約市的最新路況，建議可以參考以下幾個常用資源：

| 資源 | 特色 | 連結 |
|------|------|------|
| **Google Maps** | 提供實時交通流量、路況圖、公共交通時刻表等 | https://maps.google.com |
| **Apple Maps** | 同樣提供即時路況與公共交通資訊 | https://maps.apple.com |
| **NYC DOT Traffic** | 紐約市交通局官方網站，提供主要道路的即時交通訊息 | https://www.nyc.gov/html/dot/html/home/traffic.shtml |
| **Waze** | 社群驅動的即時路況與事故報告 | https://www.waze.com |
| **NYC Transit** | 公共交通（地鐵、巴士）實時到站資訊 | https://www.nyc.gov/site/transit/index.page |

如果您需要更具體的路段或時間段資訊，請告訴我，我可以協助您查詢相關資料或提供使用這些工具的技巧。
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "紐約目前的交通狀況如何？" meaning "What is the current traffic situation in New York?" We need to provide an answer. We might want to use the geocode_address function? But the question is about traffic. There's no function for traffic. We can respond with general info or ask for clarification. We could say we don't have real-time data. Provide suggestions.
